instructions:
# App Store Data API (MCP)

Read-only, normalized public-data reads of App Store applications exposed through the ReplyNodes fetcher domain: app lookup, bounded term search, and related-app listings.

## Surface status
-The three supported read operations are implemented and behavior-tested today in services/appstore-fetcher (issue #15): capability gating before any egress, explicit egress allowlisting including redirects, bounded timeouts and response sizes, and strict normalization into the v1 contract.
-Route paths in this catalog are stable capability identifiers used for agent tool bindings; public gateway exposure for this platform is issued to your workspace at onboarding and must not be assumed reachable anywhere else.

## How to call
- Resolve the base URL issued to your workspace at onboarding; never assume a host.
- Each tool maps to one HTTP GET capability: substitute path parameters into the endpoint path and pass optional parameters as query strings.
- Authenticate at the gateway with header `Authorization: Bearer *** API key>` or follow x402 v2 payment requirements returned as HTTP 402; the manifest holds no key or payer material.

## Results
- Success: `{"data": [app records], "meta": {"request_id": "req-...", "contract_version": "v1", "generated_at": "...", "availability": "complete"}}`.
- Failure: `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "request_id": "req-..."}}`; honor HTTP status and any `Retry-After` header.
- Report `meta.availability`, `meta.missing_fields`, and null counters honestly instead of guessing.

## Conduct
- Read-only: these tools never mutate anything; refuse requests asking them to purchase, review, submit, or touch accounts.
- Respect page bounds (20 default results, max 50); there are no continuation tokens on this surface.

tools.name: appstore_get_app
tools.title: Get one public App Store application
tools.description: Look up one public App Store application. GET /v1/appstore/app returns exactly one normalized public application record for the numeric track id or bundle id supplied via the id or appId query parameter, per contract v1 (developer, rating, pricing, genres, languages, version, release data). Callers authenticate with a ReplyNodes Bearer workspace key or settle 0.001 USDC per call via x402 v2 pay-per-request payment (HTTP 402) - no account or API key is required on the x402 path. An unknown or non-public id yields not_found.

id.description: Numeric track id (up to 19 digits) or reverse-DNS-style bundle id; provide id or appId.

appId.description: Alias for id; provide appId or id.

country.description: Optional storefront hint, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 lowercase (e.g. us).

language.description: Optional language hint, ISO 639-1 lowercase optionally followed by -<region> (e.g. en or en-us).

tools.name: appstore_search_apps
tools.title: Search public App Store applications
tools.description: Search public App Store applications by term. GET /v1/appstore/search returns zero or more normalized public application records matching the free-text term query parameter, as one bounded page (default 20 results, clamped to at most 50; no continuation tokens exist on this surface). Callers authenticate with a ReplyNodes Bearer workspace key or settle 0.002 USDC per call via x402 v2 pay-per-request payment (HTTP 402) - no account or API key is required on the x402 path.

term.description: Free-text search query; required and never empty after trimming.

limit.description: Page size bound; defaults to 20 and is clamped to at most 50 client-side.

country.description: Optional storefront hint, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 lowercase (e.g. us).

language.description: Optional language hint, ISO 639-1 lowercase optionally followed by -<region> (e.g. en or en-us).

tools.name: appstore_get_similar_apps
tools.title: List public apps related to one App Store application
tools.description: List public apps related to one App Store application. GET /v1/appstore/similar returns zero or more normalized public application records related to the app referenced by the id or appId query parameter; no continuation tokens exist on this surface. Callers authenticate with a ReplyNodes Bearer workspace key or settle 0.0015 USDC per call via x402 v2 pay-per-request payment (HTTP 402) - no account or API key is required on the x402 path.

appId.description: Alias for id; provide appId or id.

language.description: Optional language hint, ISO 639-1 lowercase optionally followed by -<region> (e.g. en or en-us).
